description: Says which documented FrontMCP version a project should read, and the endpoint that pins it. Pass the project's package.json, its lockfile (package-lock.json, yarn.lock or pnpm-lock.yaml; the part about @frontmcp/sdk is enough), or a version range. A lockfile gives the installed version; package.json only the range it allows. Call it first when you can read the project.

lockfile.description: The project's lockfile, or the lines about @frontmcp/sdk.

packageJson.description: The project's package.json, as it is.

range.description: A version or range, like "1.9.4" or "^1.9.0".

name: resolve_version
title: Find the docs version for a project
